item.title: SciRate Digest — 2026-08-19
item.description: Today's 10 papers: Non-CSS Quantum Code Embedding; Quantum simulation of slow analytic time-dependent Hamiltonians; Nearly Sample-Optimal Estimators for Quantum Rényi and Tsallis Entropies; Quantum Circuit for General Unitary: Improved T-count via Block Flattening and Dilation; Lie-Algebraic Classical Simulation of Bosonic Systems Beyond Gaussian Dynamics; Hardware-Aware Compilation and Execution of Bivariate Bicycle Codes on Neutral-Atom Systems; A Complete Classification of Complex Hadamard Matrices of Order Six; Computationally Efficient Optimization of Per-Qubit Clifford Deformation for Non-uniform Biased Noise; No extension of the Quantum Tensor Product admits a Superposition principle; A Simple Algebraic Proof of the PCP Theorem.
